newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ALBANIA V UKRAINE WORLD CUP TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIA V UKRAINE WORLD CUP TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group nine qualifier between Albania and Ukraine on Saturday. Albania: 1-Foto Strakosha; 2-Ghergji Dema, 3-Fatos Daja, 4-Eduard Abazaj, 5-Rudi Vata, 6-Salvator Kacaj, 7-Kliton Bozgo, 8-Artan Bellai, 9-Bledar Kola, 10-Altin Rraklli, 11-Fatmir Vata

Ukraine: 1-Oleg Suslov; 2-Mikhail Starostyak, 3-Serguei Bejenar, 4-Alexandr Golovko, 5-Vladislav Vachtchuk, 6-Dmitro Myhaiylenko, 7-Gennadiy Orbu, 8-Youri Kalitvintsev, 9-Vitali Kossovskii, 10-Andriy Shevchenko, 11-Serguei Rebrov.
